credibility.method: Confidence-weighted delivery rate over testable promises (MET=1, PARTIAL=0.5, MISSED=0; H=1.0,M=0.8,L=0.6), materiality-weighted by tier (Tier-1 binary outcomes 1.4x, Tier-3 soft 0.6x), shrunk toward a neutral 50 prior by 10 pseudo-observations (plus one per due-but-unverified promise) so neither a thin testable base nor a one-sided, thinly-retrieved ledger earns a confident extreme score. Bands A>=75 B>=60 C>=45 D>=30 E<30.
credibility.headline: Mostly delivered on testable promises; 31 later targets still not yet testable.
